name: analyze_path
description: Run oxide-sloc on a local directory or file path and return code metrics: source lines of code (SLOC), comment lines, blank lines, function count, class count, test count, and a per-language breakdown. Uses IEEE 1045-1992 counting methodology. Returns a compact summary suitable for agent reasoning.

path.description: Absolute or relative filesystem path to the directory or file to analyze.

config_file.description: Optional path to an .oxide-sloc.toml configuration file to use for this analysis.

name: get_metrics_latest
description: Fetch the metrics from the most recent completed scan stored on a running oxide-sloc server. Returns aggregate totals (code lines, comment lines, blank lines, functions, classes, test counts) and a per-language breakdown.

server_url.description: Base URL of the oxide-sloc server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4317). Defaults to SLOC_SERVER_URL environment variable.

name: get_metrics_history
description: Fetch time-series scan history from a running oxide-sloc server. Returns an ordered list of past scans with timestamps, git commit/branch info, and SLOC counts. Useful for trend analysis.

server_url.description: Base URL of the oxide-sloc server. Defaults to SLOC_SERVER_URL.

limit.description: Maximum number of history entries to return. Defaults to 100.

name: get_run_metrics
description: Fetch metrics for a specific scan run by its UUID run_id from a running oxide-sloc server. Use this after polling the run status to retrieve completed scan results.

run_id.description: UUID of the scan run to retrieve (e.g. 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6).

server_url.description: Base URL of the oxide-sloc server. Defaults to SLOC_SERVER_URL.

name: compare_runs
description: Compare two oxide-sloc JSON result files and return a delta summary: which languages gained or lost lines, net SLOC change, file count changes, and test count changes. Useful for code review analysis and PR metric checks.

baseline_path.description: Path to the baseline (older) JSON result file produced by oxide-sloc analyze --json-out.

current_path.description: Path to the current (newer) JSON result file to compare against the baseline.

name: health_check
description: Verify that a running oxide-sloc server is reachable and healthy. Returns the server status and version. Use this before making other API calls to confirm the server is up.

server_url.description: Base URL of the oxide-sloc server. Defaults to SLOC_SERVER_URL.

name: ingest_result
description: Push an oxide-sloc analysis result (AnalysisRun JSON) into a running server's registry. The result then appears in the server's scan history and is queryable via get_run_metrics. Use this from CI pipelines to send headless scan results to a shared server.

server_url.description: Base URL of the oxide-sloc server. Defaults to SLOC_SERVER_URL.

json_path.description: Path to an AnalysisRun JSON file on disk to upload. Mutually exclusive with json_inline.

json_inline.description: Raw AnalysisRun JSON string to upload inline. Mutually exclusive with json_path.
